findings.body: The required latest-commit proof list is missing. Historical commit messages give broad coverage summaries, but no current list maps every covered Done-when detail to its code and named proof. Supply the complete list, including agent admission, shared entry lifecycle, machine view, cancellation, diagnostics, guidance and new/existing client behavior.
findings.title: Not done: proof list

findings.body: The supported default-branch PR checker still launches Autoreview without process-group options (tests/fixtures/pr-check-before-branch-diff/review.py:531–533). This path nevertheless requests group termination for that child. codex._stop signals a group named by the child's pid (src/forge/codex.py:624–630), which does not exist for that launch; the child remains alive and stop refuses without freeing its place. Older ungrouped Claude workers and readers have the same problem. The existing-queue test converts a newly grouped worker's record, so it does not cover cancellation of an actual older launch.
findings.title: Handle existing agents without a dedicated process group

findings.body: Admission snapshots chosen here, but Autoreview defaults and unavailable-model fallback update only selected at src/forge/review.py:569–575. The running review's board entry therefore continues reporting null or the unavailable model. Split design workers similarly replace chosen when falling back to Codex at src/forge/worker.py:165–189 without updating their lane entry. Refresh the entry's model and effort when either caller changes its selection.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the selected model changes

findings.body: Actual test commands still bypass the shared entries: src/forge/fasttest.py:271 launches directly, while close uses the separate ticket queue at src/forge/review.py:279–288. Consequently, the board cannot expose their output or progress, and stop cannot cancel tests or end an item's worker and test together. plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:142 assigns this integration and its command-level checks to TESTS, so this remains deferred advice for that task.
findings.title: Later: connect test entries and cancellation in TESTS
